items.title: A dimension function on a universally catenary locally Noetherian base pulls back to a dimension function on any locally finite type scheme over it
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a locally finite type morphism to a locally Noetherian universally catenary base, the sum of a dimension function on the base and the transcendence degree of the residue field extension is a dimension function on the source (statement lines 13656-13668). The counted proof is a genuine computation with two layers of reduction: it passes to an affine chart, then to the case where both schemes are integral and the point is a generic point by restricting to the closures, reads the relevant local rings and their dimensions, and finally evaluates the difference of the candidate function along a specialization in a three-step display, using the dimension formula and catenarity of the base to cancel the base contribution and leave exactly the dimension of the local ring of the source at the specialization (proof lines 13670-13738). It is H2: the reduction and the computation are carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being the dimension formula and standard catenarity and codimension statements.
